global_blockers.message: This is an offline comparison of a saved capture; no current controller read or freshness check is performed.
Polygon coordinates do not prove sensor field of view, range, occlusion, or coverage at arm/table heights.
Controller zRange values are retained verbatim; their reference and physical height coverage are unverified.
The supplied profile defines forward travel zones only; no rearward margin profile was provided.
The profile's conservative circular turn requirement cannot be represented by a straight rectangular region comparison.
Snapshot strategy references are shown for context; runtime strategy selection and activation are not verified.

limitations: The current region polygons are copied from a saved snapshot and are not re-read from the controller.
Containment is checked on complete convex polygons, not bounding boxes.
Non-convex or unsupported controller shapes are marked unsupported rather than approximated by a rectangle.
A forward profile is not assigned to the rear-facing sensor, and rotation zones are not substituted with straight rectangles.
Negative sensor-local x candidates are reported as blocked; they do not imply the sensor can see behind itself.
No proposal is approved or applied and no controller write API is called.
